verdict.rationale: Mem0 is a memory layer for LLM agents, not an automation or workflow platform, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is outside its product category. Its webhooks and CLI are memory-event notifications and memory CRUD tools, not versionable automations, so they do not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
